newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil extends overnight gains at close.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil extends overnight gains at close.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices extended overnight gains at close on technical buying and speculation of good fundamental news. Initial price movements were tight and there were inter-month spread activity. Feb futures will deal between 1,190 and 1,230
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Saw some refiners covering and interest was confined among selected products and nearby CPOs.
End-November stocks were estimated at below one million tonnes, with trades forecasting at around 980,000 tonnes.
The market drifted in a tight range in early dealing sessions before moving up on late fresh support, they said.

"There was technical buying after February futures broke the 1,200 ringgit level," a trader said. At the close, the contract was 10 ringgit up 1,210 ringgit ($470.97) a tonne after trading between 1,195 and 1,212 level.
Traders said the next support will be at 1,190 with resistance at 1,230 level.
Trading volume on the futures market was 1,853 lots against 1,438 lots on Tuesday.

Among physicals, Dec (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,225 ringgit after trading from 1,212.50 and 1,215. Bids for Dec (south) was 1,220. Dec (central) saw offers at 1,215 and bids at 1,200, and Dec (north) at 1,215 against 1,200.
Jan (south) saw offers at 1,235 and bids at 1,230 with earlier trades at 1,225 and 1,230. Feb (south) was offered at 1,235 and bids at 1,230 after trading at 1,225 and 1,230.
Among refined products, Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $520 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/March at $517.50. Dec was traded at $517.50.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $560, Jan at $552.50 and Feb/March at $550. Jan was traded at $550.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $372.50 and Jan at $377.50. Dec was dealt at $370.
Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $302.50. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5210 ringgit)
